notes.title: Gravity Runner Available On Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664023/52bbceeb7469a46eb5adac3735350e98b1b3cf25.png[/img]

Gravity Runner is out now on the Nintendo Switch! You can now take the synthwave running action on the road and try to beat your high score wherever you want! Check it out on the Nintendo eShop today!

notes.title: Lunar New Year Sale
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40664023/26cb3d6ccd239f2a2af4953c1542be7e62916508.jpg[/img]

The Steam Lunar New Year Sale is on once again and Gravity Runner is 35% off!

Why not celebrate with some challenging synthwave platformer/runner action!?

notes.title: It's A Celebration Sale!
notes.notes: To celebrate an amazing start to the New Year, it's time to celebrate with the biggest discount yet for Gravity Runner! For one week only Gravity Runner will be 50% off!

notes.title: Gravity Runner 35% Off
notes.notes: If you're looking for a fun gift idea for the holidays, Gravity Runner is now 35% off during the Steam Winter Sale. Get it for a friend or loved one and watch them enjoy some awesome synthwave action!

notes.title: Gravity Runner Demo Live
notes.notes:
The holidays are nearly here and hopefully everyone will get a little time to do some gaming! 

To kick off some holiday fun, the Gravity Runner demo has been activated again! So get your running shoes on and get ready to experience some sweet synthwave black hole action!

notes.title: Gravity Runner Award Nomination
notes.notes:
The Steam Awards are now open for nominations and Gravity Runner is made for the category: Best Game You Suck At.

If you agree, please vote now!

notes.title: Gravity Runner Out Now
notes.notes: Gravity Runner is out now! 10% launch discount for the first week only, get it now!

notes.title: Gravity Runner Next Fest Demo
notes.notes: Hi Everyone! The Gravity Runner Demo is going to be coming down after Next Fest, so if you haven't played it yet, now is the perfect time to do it!

notes.title: Demo Out Now
notes.notes: Hi Everyone! The Gravity Runner Demo is now live!

notes.title: Demo Releasing Soon
notes.notes: Hi Everyone! Gravity Runner has a short demo coming soon! We'll let you know when it goes live!

notes.title: Playtest Over!
notes.notes: The Gravity Runner playtest has finished, thank you to everyone who participated! We had some really helpful feedback that will help shape Gravity Runner into hopefully its best version possible. Looking forward to releasing later this year.

notes.title: Only A Few Days Left!
notes.notes: The Gravity Runner playtest only has a few days left, so try it out while you still can! Playtest closing Wednesday 7 July 11:00AM AWST

notes.title: One Week Left!
notes.notes: The Gravity Runner playtest has only one week left, so try it out while you still can! 3 levels have been added for play testing and also new animated backgrounds for each level. Also we are trying out double jumping to see if it improves the gameplay experience.

notes.title: Two Weeks Down!
notes.notes: The Gravity Runner playtest has only two weeks left and the feedback has been so helpful! We've just added a new level to try out and have also fixed some small bugs you guys pointed out. Please keep sending in that feedback and please wishlist the game if you haven't already.

notes.title: One Week Down!
notes.notes: A big thank you to everyone that has been participating in the Gravity Runner playtest, we are getting some really helpful feedback and fantastic encouragement. We've been busy over the past week trying to implement some of the suggestions that we've received and we've also just added a new level today for the playtest. The playtest is open for another 3 weeks, so please feel free to give it a try. Any feedback is greatly appreciated, as it really does help with the development!

notes.title: New Level Added To Gravity Runner Playtest
notes.notes: Hi Everyone, a new level has been added to the Gravity Runner playtest, we are introducing a new dynamic... sideways gravity. Have fun and please remember to send any feedback you have on the game by clicking the link in the main menu or pause menu of the game.

notes.title: Gravity Runner Wants You!
notes.notes: Are you interested in helping shape the development of a game? Well then why not sign up to playtest Gravity Runner? We are looking for anyone that is interested in playing Gravity Runner and is able to give useful feedback to help guide the game to its best possible version. Open for 4 weeks only!
